desc: A housecat named Rusty joins ThunderClan as Firepaw — and a prophecy says fire will save the Clan. 🔥
descZh: 家猫 Rusty 以 Firepaw 之名加入雷族——预言说，火将拯救族群。

q.en: What is the housecat Rusty's name BEFORE he joins ThunderClan?
q.zh: 家猫 Rusty 在加入雷族之前叫什么名字？

explain.en: Rusty is a kittypet (housecat) who is invited to join ThunderClan and is renamed Firepaw.
explain.zh: Rusty 是一只家猫，被邀请加入雷族后改名为 Firepaw（火爪）。

q.en: Which of the four forest Clans does Rusty join?
q.zh: Rusty 加入的是森林四大猫族中的哪一个？

options.en: ShadowClan, the Clan of the pine woods
options.zh: 影族，松树林中的那个族

options.en: WindClan, the Clan of the open moor
options.zh: 风族，开阔荒原上的那个族

options.en: RiverClan, the Clan of the rushing river
options.zh: 河族，急流河畔的那个族

explain.en: He joins ThunderClan, one of the four Clans (Thunder, River, Shadow, Wind) that share the forest.
explain.zh: 他加入了雷族——与河族、影族、风族共享森林的四大猫族之一。

q.en: Who is Firepaw's first mentor in ThunderClan?
q.zh: Firepaw 在雷族的第一位导师是谁？

explain.en: Bluestar assigns Lionheart (and Tigerclaw) to mentor Firepaw; Lionheart is his primary mentor until he dies.
explain.zh: 蓝星安排狮心（与虎掌）教导 Firepaw；狮心是他主要的导师，直到牺牲。

q.en: What prophecy does Spottedleaf share that points to Firepaw?
q.zh: Spottedleaf 分享的、指向 Firepaw 的预言是什么？

options.en: Water will drown the forest and wash away the camp
options.zh: 水将淹没森林，冲走营地

options.en: The wind will carry us home across the moor
options.zh: 风将带我们越过荒原回家

options.en: Ice shall rule the Clan through the long cold
options.zh: 冰将在漫长严寒中统治族群

options.en: Fire alone can save our Clan
options.zh: 唯有火能拯救我们的族群

explain.en: Spottedleaf's prophecy — 'Fire alone can save our Clan' — refers to the flame-colored newcomer, Firepaw.
explain.zh: Spottedleaf 的预言“唯有火能拯救我们的族群”，指的就是这只火色的新成员 Firepaw。

q.en: Which ShadowClan cat kills Spottedleaf and steals the ThunderClan kits?
q.zh: 哪个影族猫杀死了 Spottedleaf 并偷走了雷族的幼猫？

explain.en: Clawface raids the camp, kills Spottedleaf the medicine cat, and carries off the four ThunderClan kits.
explain.zh: 利爪突袭营地，杀死了巫医斑叶，并叼走了雷族的四只幼猫。

q.en: Who is Tigerclaw's apprentice that secretly witnesses Redtail's murder?
q.zh: 谁是虎掌的学徒，暗中目睹了红尾被杀？

options.zh: 尘爪，那只脾气暴躁的公猫
沙爪，那只嘴尖舌利的母猫

explain.en: Ravenpaw sees Tigerclaw kill Redtail and is terrified into silence; he later flees to live as a kittypet.
explain.zh: 鸦爪亲眼看见虎掌杀死红尾，吓得不敢声张，后来逃去做了宠物猫。

q.en: Who actually killed Redtail, the ShadowClan deputy?
q.zh: 真正杀死影族副族长红尾的是谁？

options.zh: 狮心，那位勇敢的副族长

options.en: A monster (a car on the Thunderpath)
options.zh: 怪兽（雷道上的一辆汽车）

explain.en: Tigerclaw killed Redtail at the gorge and blamed Oakheart; Ravenpaw saw the truth.
explain.zh: 虎掌在峡谷边杀死了红尾，并嫁祸给橡心；鸦爪目睹了真相。

q.en: What is the name of the old ShadowClan medicine cat prisoner who becomes ThunderClan's medicine cat?
q.zh: 那位后来成为雷族巫医的、被囚禁的老影族猫叫什么？

explain.en: Yellowfang, a captured ShadowClan medicine cat, stays with ThunderClan and becomes its new medicine cat.
explain.zh: 黄牙是被俘的影族巫医，留在雷族后成为了新的巫医。

q.en: Whose kit does Firepaw rescue and bring into ThunderClan — his own nephew?
q.zh: Firepaw 救下并带进雷族的幼猫（他的亲外甥）是谁？

options.en: Brackenkit, a kit of the ThunderClan nursery
options.zh: 蕨崽，雷族育婴室里的一只幼崽
捷崽，风族来的一只幼崽

options.en: Tiny, the runt who later became Scourge
options.zh: 小不点，那只弱崽，后来成了长鞭

explain.en: Firepaw's kittypet sister Princess gives him one of her kits; he brings the kit (Cloudkit, later Cloudtail) to ThunderClan.
explain.zh: Firepaw 的家猫姐姐 Princess 送给他一只幼猫，他把云崽（后来的云尾）带进了雷族。

q.en: What warrior name does Firepaw receive at the end of the book?
q.zh: 在书末，Firepaw 获得了什么武士名？

options.en: Firestorm, a name some cats expected
options.zh: 火暴，一些猫预料中的名字

options.en: Emberpaw, left over from his apprentice days
options.zh: 余烬爪，沿用他学徒时期的称呼

options.en: Flamefur, a name for a different Clan
options.zh: 焰毛，属于另一个族的名字

explain.en: Firepaw becomes the warrior Fireheart; his friend Graypaw becomes Graystripe. (Ravenpaw leaves to live as a kittypet with Barley.)
explain.zh: Firepaw 成为武士火星，好友灰爪成为灰条。（鸦爪则离开，与大麦一起做了宠物猫。）
